name: Rosa's Bakery
blurb: Replies to customer messages and writes marketing copy. The public can message it.

answers.text: We are a three person bakery. I answer the same Instagram questions all day and I would like help replying without sounding like a robot. Some customers ask about allergens.

name: Northside Physio
blurb: Drafts letters from patient notes, so the data rules are strict.

answers.text: Two physiotherapists and a receptionist. We want help drafting referral letters and replying to patient emails. Patient notes will go in, so privacy is the whole question.

name: Kwan Accounting
blurb: Bookkeeping and client documents. Payment and tax records go in.

answers.text: Small accounting practice with about forty clients. We want to categorise expenses, summarise contracts and draft client emails. Tax records and bank statements are involved.
